title: Choose the Helios Alpha visual world
question: The roll assigned Signal Lab Patch Manual. Keep it, take the research-forward alternate, or choose a sharper challenger.

options.label: Signal Lab Patch Manual
options.lineage: modular signal laboratories and field-service foldouts
options.thesis: A strategy becomes legible by tracing one event through typed, reconnectable stages.
options.viewport: A live signal path routes one synthetic event through reorder, bucket, moments, threshold, and checkpoint stages.
options.risk: It becomes a toy if the connectors are decorative instead of functional.

raised.raise: Configuration density is concentrated into one specification band so the signal path stays calm.
Every stage owns a hard plane with unambiguous order and responsibility.
The event pulse changes atmosphere as state accumulates without obscuring the data.

options.label: Annotated Event Atlas
options.lineage: event-study papers, lab notebooks, and transparent plot overlays
options.thesis: Rare-event research reads as a sequence of evidence plates with claims attached to exact observations.
options.viewport: An aligned-time event study dominates the first screen while marginal notes explain its restartable computation.
options.risk: It can settle into familiar quant-paper territory without a strong interactive mechanism.

options.label: Event-Time Cutting Bench
options.lineage: analog film editing benches and contact sheets
options.thesis: Replay, watermarking, and checkpoints become physical cuts along one inspectable event-time rail.
options.viewport: A horizontal event-time rail exposes late arrivals, bucket boundaries, and a draggable checkpoint splice.
options.case: It explains temporal semantics exceptionally well, but strategy composition is less immediate than the assigned direction.
options.risk: The cinematic metaphor can overpower the generic streaming model.

options.label: Queue Depth Scroller
options.lineage: early computer demos and horizontal raster scrollers
options.thesis: A relentless event tape makes queue depth, ordering, and latency impossible to ignore.
options.viewport: An event queue scrolls across the first screen and branches into reducer and signal lanes with live counters.
options.case: It has the strongest systems identity, but it risks the familiar dark trading-terminal category rut.
options.risk: Visual intensity can reduce long-form reading comfort.

options.label: Strategy Obi
options.lineage: Tokyo boutique-pop sleeves with dense information bands
options.thesis: A compact strategy manifest wraps a nearly empty signal surface.
options.viewport: A dense configuration band frames one sparse statistical plot.
options.case: The density contrast is useful, but it does not support a long-form researcher workflow.
options.risk: It reads as packaging before it reads as an instrument.
options.kept: Concentrate dense configuration into one controlled band.

options.label: Precisionist Process Plate
options.lineage: precisionist industrial paintings and cutaway machinery plates
options.thesis: Streaming stages become monumental planes with hard mechanical hierarchy.
options.viewport: A cutaway pipeline fills the frame as if every state transition were part of a machine.
options.case: The hierarchy is strong, but the monumental scale works against rapid experimentation.
options.risk: The system feels fixed when the product promise is pluggability.
options.kept: Give each pipeline stage a hard visual boundary and clear responsibility.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.lineage: quarry sections, weather charts, and atmospheric strata
options.thesis: Rare events are cut from temporal weather systems and assembled into statistical blocks.
options.viewport: A broad event horizon dissolves into cut statistical strata beneath it.
options.case: The temporal atmosphere is evocative, but the composition model is too indirect.
options.kept: Let accumulation subtly change the atmosphere around the event pulse.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished VitePress documentation site with conventional navigation, search, and blue-accented code examples.
canonCard.viewport: A centered hero introduces the library above feature cards and a conventional documentation shell.
canonCard.risk: It is useful and credible, but indistinguishable from the category by design.
